;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Gaza–Israel clashes (May 2019)]], [[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Hamas]] and other militant groups in the [[Gaza Strip]] fire hundreds of rockets at [[Israel]], killing two Israeli civilians in [[Ashkelon]] and one in [[Ashdod]]. Retaliatory Israeli strikes on Gaza kill at least 23 [[Palestinians]], including a senior Hamas commander. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/middleeast/israel-airstrikes-gaza-rockets-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/430-gaza-rockets-fired-at-israel-one-israeli-dead-six-palestinians-said-killed-1.7199036 (''Haartez'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[Taliban]] insurgents kill 13 and injure 55 people in an attack on a police headquarters in [[Puli Khumri]], [[Afghanistan]], using guns and suicide vests. The Taliban's high command recently rejected a ceasefire offer from the Afghan government. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48169104 (BBC News)]
*The [[United States]] deploys [[Carrier Strike Group 12|a carrier strike group]] and a bomber task force to the Middle East to respond to threats from [[Iran]]. A U.S. official told [[CNN]], "... the threats were against both U.S. maritime and land-based forces in the region." [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/politics/iran-carrier-bomber-task-force/index.html (CNN)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Aeroflot Flight 1492]]
**At least 41 passengers are killed after [[Sukhoi Superjet 100]] (flight SU1492), which suffered an inflight fire,  is engulfed by fire after an emergency crash landing at [[Sheremetyevo International Airport]], [[Moscow]], Russia. A five-person crew and 73 passengers were on board. [https://www.aviation24.be/airlines/aeroflot/sukhoi-superjet-makes-emergency-landing-at-moscow-sheremetyevo-after-a-fire-on-board/ (Aviation 24)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48171392 (BBC News)]
*Seven [[Venezuela]]n military officers are killed in a helicopter crash. [https://www.apnews.com/056d93e06fc146048be64fa0272bb5aa (AP)]
;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[President of the National Assembly of Venezuela]] [[Juan Guaidó]] tells the [[BBC]] he is considering formally requesting the [[United States]] to launch a [[Humanitarian intervention|military intervention]] to topple [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. Guaidó led a [[2019 Venezuela uprising|failed uprising]] against Maduro last month. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48172520?ocid=socialflow_twitter (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in Brunei]]
**[[List of Sultans of Brunei|Brunei's Sultan]] [[Hassanal Bolkiah]] announces, via a television broadcast, that he has extended the moratorium on capital punishment for gay sex convictions. No executions have been carried out in [[Brunei]] since 1957. There has been  overwhelming international backlash against a number of the changes affected by the stricter interpretation of [[Sharia|Islamic law]] published on 3 April 2019.  The Sultan also said Brunei will ratify the [[United Nations Convention against Torture]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48171165 (BBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/asia/brunei-lgbt-death-penalty-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 North Macedonian presidential election]]
**Voters in [[North Macedonia]] head to the polls for the second round of the 2019 presidential election. [[Stevo Pendarovski]] of the [[Social Democratic Union of Macedonia]] wins over his opponent [[Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-macedonia-election/north-macedonias-pro-western-candidate-wins-presidential-vote-idUSKCN1SA0SO (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/05/world/europe/north-macedonia-election.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2019 Panamanian general election]]
** [[Laurentino Cortizo]] of the center-left [[Democratic Revolutionary Party]] defeats [[Rómulo Roux]] of the center-right [[Democratic Change (Panama)|Democratic Change]] party in a narrow election to become the next president of [[Panama]]. Cortizo receives 33% of the vote to Roux's 31%, marking the return of the [[Democratic Revolutionary Party]] after 10 years out of the presidency. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48174497 (BBC News)]
